title: La encomienda
goal: Send a package to somebody in another town
culture: Parcels travel by bus. You hand it over, pay a little, it rides in the same hold as everybody’s shopping, and somebody collects it at the other terminal. There is no tracking of any kind and it works, but only if a real person knows to be there.

beats.objective: Yes — you want to send this
beats.good: Mandar esto, with the parcel held out. The whole system is a man, a bus and somebody waiting at the other end.
The destination is a town, and every town has one terminal. That is the entire address.

beats.es: Va. Sale en el de las tres.
beats.objective: Ask whether it gets there today
beats.good: It will. The bus takes an hour and your parcel is going in the hold with everybody’s shopping.

beats.es: Llega hoy mismo, como a las cuatro.
beats.good: Ask, because the answer is a person and not an office. Somebody has to be standing at that terminal when the bus pulls in.
